description: Commissioned swerve PID gains for the YORv3 base. Applied to controller RAM by tools/base_pid_preflight.py before robot/yor.py opens the motor controllers. RAM is not persistent: re-run the preflight after every SPARK power cycle.

drive.notes: Feed-forward dominated rather than a conventional PD loop. Kd is deliberately zero: a tested value of 10 caused an audibly harsh 100 Hz torque ripple and rough deceleration during floor testing.

steering.notes: The +/-0.25 output limit is part of the commissioned set. Full-range steering (Kp=10, Kd=0, output -1.0..1.0) is NOT validated and must stay a separate commissioning experiment.
